product: Migrate a Postgres database to Lakebase (Beta)
tagline: You can now copy an existing PostgreSQL database into a Lakebase project in a single, one time migration.
what_it_does: You can now copy an existing PostgreSQL database into a Lakebase project in a single, one time migration. Lakebase assesses the source database for compatibility, then copies its roles, schema, and data to a branch that you choose. Migrations are available in the Lakebase App and through the Postgres API and SDKs, with no separate enablement step.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: You can now copy an existing PostgreSQL database into a Lakebase project in a single, one time migration. Lakebase assesses the source database for compatibility, then copies its roles, schema, and data to a branch that you choose.
